releases.notes:
## Changelog V2.0.0

- Added NeoForge support
- Added Quilt support
- Now supports every Minecraft version from 1.20 to 26.2
- Fixed the swap keybind resetting to default every time you restarted the game
- Fixed the Elytra counting as a chestplate on 1.21.2 and later, which could swap an Elytra for another Elytra instead of your chestplate

# Elytra Swapper v1.1.0 Release Notes

## Update Overview

We are excited to announce that **Elytra Swapper** has been successfully ported to Minecraft version 1.21! This update brings the mod up to date with the latest Minecraft release, ensuring compatibility with new features and improvements.

## Changelog

- **Ported to Minecraft 1.21**: Updated the mod to work with Minecraft version 1.21, including necessary adjustments for compatibility with new game mechanics and APIs.
- **General Improvements**: Minor bug fixes and optimizations to enhance performance and stability.

## Installation

1. **Download the Updated Mod**:
   - Get the latest release JAR file from the [Releases page](https://github.com/SaolGhra/ElytraSwapper/releases).

2. **Update Your Installation**:
   - Replace the existing Elytra Swapper JAR file in your `mods` folder with the newly downloaded version.

3. **Launch Minecraft**:
   - Start Minecraft using the Fabric profile. The mod should now be updated and functional with Minecraft 1.21.

## Known Issues

- No significant issues reported. If you encounter any problems, please report them on the [GitHub Issues page](https://github.com/SaolGhra/ElytraSwapper/issues).

## Thank You!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy the updated version of Elytra Swapper! 

For further updates and support, follow us on [GitHub](https://github.com/SaolGhra/ElytraSwapper).

Happy modding!
